mission: Continuously improve research depth, factual discipline, originality, mechanism clarity, audience understanding and outcome calibration.

lessons.title: Evidence hierarchy
lessons.principle: Primary/verified evidence outranks discovery leads and narrative repetition.
lessons.training_drill: Classify 20 claims as VERIFIED_FACT, DERIVED_OBSERVATION, INTERPRETATION, HYPOTHESIS or UNKNOWN.
lessons.failure_mode: Turning a headline or social narrative into a factual claim.
lessons.epistemic_rule: Never promote an observation to a fact without verification.

lessons.title: Novelty before publication
lessons.principle: A strong opportunity can still be blocked when the draft repeats recently published language or thesis.
lessons.training_drill: Generate three materially different angles for the same evidence and reject semantic duplicates.
lessons.failure_mode: Repeated sentence, repeated hook, repeated thesis.
lessons.epistemic_rule: Never promote an observation to a fact without verification.

lessons.title: Mechanism over hype
lessons.principle: Every market claim should explain the observable mechanism and its invalidation conditions.
lessons.training_drill: For each thesis write catalyst -> mechanism -> evidence -> invalidation.
lessons.failure_mode: Price-only prediction with no causal/mechanistic explanation.
lessons.epistemic_rule: Never promote an observation to a fact without verification.

lessons.title: Adversarial thinking
lessons.principle: A publishable thesis must survive credible counter-evidence.
lessons.training_drill: Produce bull/base/bear cases and identify the single strongest disconfirming fact.
lessons.epistemic_rule: Never promote an observation to a fact without verification.

lessons.title: Learn without copying
lessons.principle: Historical engagement is observational guidance, not proof of causality or permission to copy creators.
lessons.training_drill: Compare formats with at least three samples and label confidence as observational.
lessons.epistemic_rule: Never promote an observation to a fact without verification.

lessons.title: Close the prediction loop
lessons.principle: Every eligible prediction/setup should later be reconciled with its realized outcome.
lessons.training_drill: For each historical setup, record thesis, timestamp, evidence, outcome and what changed.
lessons.epistemic_rule: Never promote an observation to a fact without verification.

evaluation_contract.scoring_policy: Use component scores for diagnostics only; never convert them into permission to bypass mandatory gates.

hard_boundary: This layer trains process and evaluation memory; it does not claim to train or fine-tune an external foundation model.
